item: Schedule status says so when nothing is left to resume collection after an exclusive operation
summary: When an exclusive operation ended and the OS refused both the collection loop's thread and the pending-resume watcher's thread, the only trace was a WARNING in a log: the Schedule payload read as an idle collector and, with autostart off, nothing restarted it until the operator pressed Start. status() now carries resume_abandoned (since, the CLASS of each refusal, never its words, and what to do), None when a loop runs or a watcher waits. It is cleared by any successful start(), a later resume that works, or a shutdown. Payload only: the Schedule tab does not draw it yet (separate UI item, shared file app-core.js). 6 new tests, each of four mutants (no clear on start, no clear on resume, the words recorded, no clear on cancel) turns one red. Found while reading the refused-loop-start fix (PR #1702).
